name: Obligation Fulfilment
definition: Processes by which an obligation is extinguished fully or partially.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date and time on which assets become available.

ObligationOffset.name: Obligation Offset
ObligationOffset.definition: Specifies the obligation which has been offset for instance a payment obligation or a securities delivery.

ResultingObligation.name: Resulting Obligation
ResultingObligation.definition: Specifies the obligation which result from a settlement process, for instance the remaining obligation when the obligations are netted.
